features: Start Your Child’s Musical Journey By Gifting Them a Casio Mini Keyboard
The SA-46 Features 32 Mini Sized Keys Which are a Great Fit For Kids
Explore The 100 Tones and 50 Rhythms and Find an Incredible Variety of Lifelike Instruments
The SA-46 Features 10 Built-In Songs To Play Along with Which’ll Keep Your Little Ones Engaged
Comes with 5 On-Board Percussion Pads Along with a Piano/Organ Button
The SA-46 Comes with A 3.5 mm Jack To Connect Headphones So That Your Child Can Practice in Peace
The SA-46 is Extremely Portable and Can Be Operated via 6 AA Batteries
Durable, Easy To Handle with Trusted Japanese Quality
